concept.literalSynthesis: The supplied parents are empty synthetic Terraria contexts named Unknown, with no recorded appearance to preserve. The authored result is a compact surveyor's pick with a luminous ore lens and a returning crescent head; those details are new design choices, not claims about either parent.
concept.coreMechanic: A 55% pick tool mines through its native primary-use action while launching a straight 24-damage bolt. Alternate use refreshes a modest utility group and sends a returning 18-damage crescent. While the item is selected, the same group is refreshed with spelunker ore highlighting and 0.5 HP/s regeneration. The synthetic parents provide no damage, timing, rarity, acquisition, or progression facts, so these bounded values are authored choices rather than inferred upgrades. The generated effect lasts 3 seconds and has 6 seconds of exhaustion, making held refresh a periodic benefit rather than free permanent uptime. The bolt and crescent are separate projectiles with independently authored collision and motion.
concept.parentAContribution: Parent A is an empty synthetic Terraria context with no observed appearance or abilities. Its contribution is a newly authored surveyor-tool role: the straight bolt accompanies the native pick action.
concept.parentBContribution: Parent B is likewise an empty synthetic context with no observed appearance or abilities. Its contribution is a newly authored returning crescent action and the ore-survey theme; these are design inventions, not inherited effects.
concept.playerExperience: Primary use mines and fires a straight bolt; alternate use sends a returning crescent and refreshes a modest utility effect. Holding the selected item periodically renews that effect, subject to its 6-second exhaustion policy.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Mine with the native pick and fire the straight damaging bolt.
Launch the returning crescent and refresh the named ore-survey effect group.
While the item remains selected, periodically refresh the effect group for ore highlighting and modest life regeneration.

realization.description: Primary use works as a mining pick and fires a straight bolt. Alternate use refreshes the ore survey group and launches a returning crescent. While you keep the item selected, ore highlighting and 0.5 HP/s regeneration are refreshed when the group's 6-second exhaustion allows; each application lasts 3 seconds. The native ore highlighting covers eligible treasure such as ores, chests, and life crystals. Projectile damage, lifetime, and return behavior are authored separately from the pick's mining power.
realization.playerExperience: The held utility has downtime by design. The two shots use different damage classes and motion, while the pick's native power applies to its own active mining use.
realization.selfEvaluation: The supplied synthetic parents contain no facts, so all mechanics and numeric values are authored choices.
